extra.tokenisation: word: lowercase NFC maximal runs of letters/marks/digits with inner apostrophes; every token holds a letter (pure numbers dropped); URLs ('://' or leading 'www.') dropped as chunks; no punctuation tokens. Sentences end at . ! ? plus whitespace.
extra.docDef: one email (after cleaning and exact de-duplication on header+body; the ten mailboxes' 60 monthly files are pooled). Most emails are 1-3 sentences, so documents are short.
extra.source: enron/*/*.txt (10 mailboxes, FERC release via CMU)
extra.notes: Workplace email BODIES only: header lines, quoted lines (leading '>'), and everything from the first fence line (>=4 of one of - _ = * ~, i.e. forwarded/original-message markers, signature rules, disclaimers) are cut by line shape; 3553 emails parsed, 662 had no body left, 1625 exact duplicates (same header+body, e.g. filed in several folders) dropped. The corpus bodies are truncated at the source, so ~65% of the raw bytes were headers/quotes/duplicates: only ~34k tokens survive. Cap: 1266/1266 documents, 33619/33619 tokens kept (whole documents by sha256(id:docIndex) order, max 300000).
